name: Halifax Regional Fire & Emergency incident feed
purpose: Fire, rescue, medical-assistance and collision dispatch context, call number and responding units.

name: HRFE incident feed automated Bluesky mirrors
latency: up to ~5 minutes per mirror disclosure
purpose: Near-real-time fallback for HRFE dispatch fields when the official HTML feed blocks or changes; retains call number, location and responding units.

name: HRFE Incident Initial Response open data
purpose: Second HRFE incident path and post-incident enrichment. Source timestamps are preserved without guessed offset correction.

name: Halifax Regional Police releases
purpose: Police incident context and later corroboration.

name: HRM newsroom
purpose: Municipal public-safety, transportation, road-closure and disruption notices across newsroom categories.

name: RCMP Nova Scotia releases
purpose: HRM-area RCMP incident context.

name: Halifax Transit GTFS-Realtime alerts
purpose: Service disruptions, detours and alerts that can reveal road incidents.

name: 511 Nova Scotia traffic events
purpose: Road incidents, closures, construction and bridge activity.

name: HRM active street closures
purpose: Active planned/permitted street closures, detours and traffic-impact context.

name: Halifax Harbour Bridges traffic
purpose: Macdonald and MacKay closure, restriction and traffic context.

name: Halifax Water notices
purpose: Water work, emergency repairs, outages and traffic impacts.

name: Environment Canada Halifax alerts
purpose: Weather warnings that can explain emergency response or disruption.

name: Nova Scotia Power outage context
purpose: Power outages and restoration context using a secondary machine-readable helper linked back to the official map.

name: Emergency Info Nova Scotia
purpose: Provincial active emergency public-message layer used by Emergency Info Nova Scotia.

name: HRM Bluesky
purpose: Municipal emergency, closure and public-safety posts.

name: Local Bluesky account feeds
purpose: Halifax Fire, Transit, Events and Halifax Noise author feeds.

name: Bluesky public search
purpose: Broad Halifax siren, emergency, crash, fire, police, ambulance and downtown queries; direct and cached AppView hosts are probed.

name: r/halifax and r/NovaScotia
purpose: Fast eyewitness/context layer from r/halifax and r/NovaScotia; recent high-comment threads are enriched with top public comments. Usernames are not persisted.

name: Local/provincial news and RSS/search feeds
purpose: CBC Nova Scotia, CTV Atlantic, Global Halifax, CityNews, Halifax Examiner, The Coast, Waterfront Media, Nova Scotia traffic/EMO RSS, Google News and Bing News filtered to incident/disruption terms.

name: Downtown Halifax event listings
purpose: Same-day event context for crowds, road impacts and unusual activity.

name: Port of Halifax cruise schedule
purpose: Same-day harbour and cruise activity context.
